name: Command sequence formal parameters
purpose: The csp table defines the formal parameters of command sequences, one record per formal parameter. A formal parameter is an argument of the sequence: a placeholder whose value the user provides (or accepts as default) when loading the sequence, and which is propagated to every element parameter mapped to it in SDF (SDF_VTYPE=F) - a command parameter or a parameter of a nested sequence. In this way one sequence works as a template, and fewer sequences need to be defined. Several element parameters may share one formal parameter if they have the same raw and engineering formats. The definition mirrors that of command parameters: type and length (PTC/PFC), display format and radix, calibration category with references to numeric (CCA) or textual (PAF) (de-)calibrations, a range set (PRF), unit and a default value with its representation; 'Command ID' and 'Parameter ID' types are supported. Formal parameters representing a command or sequence name are foreseen (CSP_TYPE C/S) but not supported by current SCOS-2000 versions. Formal parameter names need only be unique within their sequence. Since SCOS-2000 R5.0 these tables are converted on request into XML sequence definitions held in the FARC rather than the run-time MIB, imported as a delta without re-importing the TM/TC database.

fields.name: CSP_SQNAME
fields.description: Name of the sequence (CSF_NAME) owning the formal parameter.

fields.name: CSP_FPNAME
fields.description: Name of the formal parameter; unique within the sequence but not necessarily across sequences. Referenced by SDF_VALUE (VTYPE=F) of the same sequence, by SDF_PNAME when the sequence is nested, and by CSS_ELEMID for formal-parameter elements.

fields.name: CSP_FPNUM
fields.description: Number of the formal parameter within the sequence, used to order the parameters (and, for a nested sequence, quoted in SDF_POS). Numbers must be consecutive without gaps. Range 0 to 65535 as from R5.0; 0 to 999 in earlier releases.

fields.name: CSP_DESCR
fields.description: Textual description of the formal parameter.

fields.name: CSP_PTC
fields.description: Parameter Type Code (see Appendix A), with the same meaning as CPC_PTC. It must equal the PTC of every element parameter associated with this formal parameter.

fields.name: CSP_PFC
fields.description: Parameter Format Code, giving the length together with CSP_PTC within the ranges of Appendix A. It must equal the PFC of every associated element parameter.

fields.name: CSP_DISPFMT
fields.description: Input/display format of engineering values for calibrated and time parameters, as for CPC_DISPFMT. It must be equivalent to that of every associated element parameter, and is unused for 'Command ID' (CATEG=A) and 'Parameter ID' (CATEG=P) parameters.

fields.name: CSP_RADIX
fields.description: Default radix for displaying the raw value of an unsigned integer formal parameter; it may differ from the radix of the associated element parameters.

values.meaning: Associated with one or more element parameters.

fields.name: CSP_VTYPE
fields.description: Representation of the default value CSP_DEFVAL. Must be filled for type P when a default is given, and must be empty for types C and S.

values.meaning: Default value written in engineering representation; only for calibrated parameters (CSP_CATEG T or C).

fields.name: CSP_DEFVAL
fields.description: Default value of the formal parameter; its maximum length depends on the maximum command size. For type P it is written as stated by CSP_VTYPE (raw compatible with CSP_PTC and CSP_RADIX, engineering compatible with CSP_DISPFMT). For 'Command ID' (CATEG=A) it names a fully defaulted command (CCF_CNAME); for 'Parameter ID' (CATEG=P) a monitoring parameter with an on-board identifier (PCF_PID). For types C and S it would be a valid command or sequence name. If empty, the user must enter a value before loading the sequence.

fields.name: CSP_CATEG
fields.description: Calibration or special processing category, as CPC_CATEG. It must be empty or N for non-numeric raw types (strings, times) unless the parameter is a 'Command ID' or 'Parameter ID'. Options A and P are only allowed if every element parameter mapped to this formal parameter is of the same special type.

values.meaning: No calibration or special processing (import default).

fields.name: CSP_PRFREF
fields.description: Name of the range set (PRF_NUMBR) checking the formal parameter value; its format (PRF_DSPFMT) must suit CSP_PTC or CSP_DISPFMT depending on PRF_INTER. Must be empty for types C and S. It need not be the range set of the associated element parameters, but a different set is only safe if it is more restrictive (all its values allowed for every associated element parameter). When sequences are loaded only formal parameter values are range-checked by default (see PRF).

fields.name: CSP_CCAREF
fields.description: Name of the numeric (de-)calibration curve (CCA_NUMBR), compatible with CSP_PTC and CSP_DISPFMT. Must be empty if CSP_CATEG is empty, A, P, N or T, filled if C or B, empty for types C and S, and if filled it must be the same curve as used by every associated element parameter.

fields.name: CSP_PAFREF
fields.description: Name of the textual (de-)calibration (PAF_NUMBR), whose aliases may serve as values; its raw format must suit CSP_PTC. Must be empty if CSP_CATEG is empty, A, P, N or C, filled if T or B, empty for types C and S, and if filled the same as used by every associated element parameter.

fields.name: CSP_UNIT
fields.description: Engineering unit mnemonic displayed with the value; it should agree with the unit of every associated element parameter.

relationships.note: Owning sequence; CSF_NFPARS should equal the number of CSP records.
Element parameters of the same sequence inheriting the value.
When the sequence is nested, its formal parameters are addressed as element parameters of the parent.
Formal parameter standing for an element (future extension).

history: ICD 5.1 (2001, section 3.3.3.3.4, PDF p.89-92) has the same 16 fields, but CSP_FPNUM is Number(3), CSP_PRFREF, CSP_CCAREF and CSP_PAFREF are Number(4), CSP_DEFVAL is Char(17), and the special categories A and P are absent. ICD 6.0 added the 'Command ID'/'Parameter ID' types (Annex 1, PDF p.249) and the identifiers became Char(10) (PDF p.247); ICD 6.5 extended CSP_FPNUM to 65535 for R5.0 (PDF p.256). ICD 6.7 Draft A (PDF p.173-179) and ICD 6.9 (PDF p.177-183) have CSP_FPNUM Number(5) and Char(10) references. ICD 7.0 (PDF p.184-191) makes CSP_DEFVAL variable-length (S2K-8073, PDF p.261). pyscos2000 (ICD 7.2) has the same 16 columns, keys (CSP_SQNAME, CSP_FPNAME), mandatory fields and defaults (R, D, N).
notes: No discrepancy in columns, order, keys or optionality between ICD 7.0, pyscos2000 and the Solar Orbiter csp.dat (16 columns; 10981 records in 2025, 5598 in 2020). All formal parameters are of CSP_TYPE P; CSP_FPNUM runs consecutively from 1 (maximum 217) in every sequence, i.e. the value 0 is never used. CSP_VTYPE is filled in every record (R 9124, E 1857), including the 4515 records without default value where the ICD makes it optional. Categories: N 8864, T 1765 (all with DISPFMT A), C 312, P 38, A 2. CSP_DEFVAL reaches 40 characters. One reference does not resolve: CSP_PRFREF 'VSM00001' of formal parameter XC534C01 of sequence ADMC534C has no PRF record; all CSP_CCAREF and CSP_PAFREF values resolve.
